title: Palindrome Linked List
statement: Given the head of a singly linked list, return true if it is a palindrome or false otherwise.
hints: Find the middle of the list using fast & slow pointers.
Reverse the second half of the linked list in-place.
Compare first half and reversed second half node by node.

solutions.title: Array Copy Two Pointers

editorial.approach: Three-phase in-place technique: 1) Find the middle of the list using fast and slow pointers. 2) Reverse the second half of the linked list in-place. 3) Compare nodes from the head and the reversed second half node-by-node. Optionally restore the list before returning.
editorial.why_optimal: Checks palindrome property in O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space, unlike copying to an array which uses O(n) memory.
editorial.pitfalls: Uneven list length termination: on odd-length lists, the middle node belongs to the first half and should not cause mismatch errors. Pointer disconnection during the second-half reversal.
